content.short: Bonsai enables limitless computation across all blockchains.
content.description: Bonsai is a ZK coprocessor designed for Ethereum. Developers can focus on building their applications without wrestling with proof orchestration or server infrastructure. It enables any coder, regardless of language or chain, to perform massively parallel zero-knowledge proving across supported networks. Bonsai also guards against supply chain risks by letting users download and validate ZK proofs, ensuring the code runs pre-audited within Bonsai.
content.meta: Bonsai enables limitless computation across all blockchains. Discover Bonsai and other Zero Knowledge Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
